title: H4 fix round 3: the reservation is made for the executor that actually runs (dispatch passes account/executor to the worker or the worker reserves), the estimate never falls to zero tokens, a failed dispatch stamp releases its reservation, and reconcile_dead reuses tick's pool (review T-0397)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain ade6b74, 530c2ab, c1ba47c and aca3bb2 (T-0362, T-0392, T-0395) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0397 on T-0395, all four findings to address:
1. (med) orchestrator/daemon.py:528 dispatch picks an account or executor only to gate pool.reserve, then spawn_async(_dispatch_worker, id, prompt) re-selects independently; reserve is idempotent by task id, so the worker's second reserve silently returns the reservation made under the first pick even when the real executor differs. Fix: make one selection authoritative: dispatch passes the chosen account or executor id into the worker (extra argument) and the worker uses it, or dispatch does not reserve and the worker reserves once for the executor it actually starts (refusal there leaves the task queued with hold_note budget exactly as dispatch's refusal does). Either way a reservation's owner equals the running executor; test test_reservation_owner_matches_running_executor.
2. (med) orchestrator/pool.py:210 _reservation_estimate falls back to est_tokens 0 when fewer than 5 runs exist and no usd-per-token ratio is configured, so the daily-token check can never trip for new accounts or executors. Fix: when no history and no ratio, estimate tokens from the role's per-run usd cap with a documented default ratio ([limits].default_tokens_per_usd, default 250000, a conservative Sonnet-class figure labelled as an estimate) so est_tokens is always positive; test test_estimate_never_zero_without_history.
3. (low) orchestrator/daemon.py:534 reserve runs before stamp(dispatched_at); when the stamp fails (already dispatched elsewhere) the reservation leaks until the lease sweep. Release it immediately when the stamp fails; test test_failed_dispatch_stamp_releases_reservation.
4. (low) orchestrator/daemon.py:354 reconcile_dead builds a new Pool() per dead task; pass tick's pool through (parameter with default None falling back to Pool() for direct callers).
Keep every T-0362, T-0392 and T-0395 test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows aca3bb2, c1ba47c, 530c2ab and ade6b74 below your commit
tests/test_pool.py::test_estimate_never_zero_without_history passes and pool.toml documents [limits].default_tokens_per_usd as an estimate
reconcile_dead accepts a pool argument and tick passes its pool (grep)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
